messages:
tom_acme: hi — our checkout is failing. Since yesterday's deploy we get 400s from function/tool calls. model returns function call but runtime rejects with "Invalid function arguments: parse error". latency also up ~200ms. hitting ~2% of requests. request id req_abc123

emily_support: sorry about that — can you paste the exact model output and the request id? any example payload?

tom_acme: req_abc123. model output (copied): {"name":"create_order","arguments":"{\"order_ids\":[\"12345\"]}"} — note arguments is a string. we call via node sdk v2.1.0.

raj_eng: thanks, that double-encoded arguments looks like JSON-mode/serializer mismatch. can you run a quick cURL to repro?

raj_eng: ```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/complete \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-base","input":"call fn","function_call": {"name":"create_order","arguments":"{\"order_ids\":[\"12345\"]}"}}'
```

tom_acme: repro'd — get 400 with parse error. log shows: 

laura_sre: ```
error: function-arg-parse-failed
details: "Unexpected token " in JSON at position 0"
model_output.arguments: "\"{\\\"order_ids\\\":[\\\"12345\\\"]}\"
```

emily_support: root cause appears to be the model emitting a string for the arguments field (double-encoded). workaround options: 1) client-side: don't stringify arguments when calling the SDK, or if you already receive a string, parse it before sending to runtime; 2) server-side short-term: set a flag to accept stringified arguments and auto-parse (we can enable for affected customers); 3) longer-term: runtime should attempt a single parse if arguments is a string and schema expects an object.

raj_eng: agree. i'll open a staged patch to detect string-typed arguments and attempt JSON.parse once, with clear telemetry + failure reason if parse fails. preparing hotfix to reduce customer impact.

deploy-bot: Deploy rpatch-2026-02-21-334 -> staging :rocket:

tom_acme: thanks — this is part of our order flow. keep me posted.

emily_support: will follow up with timeline and mitigation steps (we can enable auto-parse for your org while fix rolls). :thumbsup:
